```{ojs}
//| echo: false
buildQuiz = function(id, title, questions) {
  const outer = html`<div id="${id}" style="margin:18px 0 24px 0;text-align:center;">
    <button style="
      display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea 0%,#764ba2 100%);
      color:#fff;border:none;padding:9px 22px;border-radius:50px;
      font-size:.95em;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;
      box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(102,126,234,.45);
      transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s;"
      onmouseover="this.style.transform='scale(1.04)';this.style.boxShadow='0 5px 18px rgba(102,126,234,.55)'"
      onmouseout="this.style.transform='scale(1)';this.style.boxShadow='0 3px 12px rgba(102,126,234,.45)'"
    >
      <span style="font-size:1.1em;">📝</span> ${title}
      <span class="chevron" style="transition:transform .3s;">▼</span>
    </button>
    <div class="quiz-body" style="
      max-height:0;opacity:0;overflow:hidden;
      transition:max-height .5s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),opacity .4s ease,margin-top .3s ease;
      margin-top:0;text-align:left;">
      <button class="close-btn" style="
        display:block;margin:0 auto 10px auto;
        background:rgba(102,126,234,.12);color:#667eea;border:none;
        padding:5px 18px;border-radius:50px;font-size:.85em;
        font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Hide Quiz</button>
      <p style="text-align:center;color:#718096;font-style:italic;font-size:.9em;margin-bottom:12px;">
        Select an answer for each question.</p>
    </div>
  </div>`;
  const toggle = outer.querySelector("button");
  const chevron = toggle.querySelector(".chevron");
  const body   = outer.querySelector(".quiz-body");
  const closeBtn = body.querySelector(".close-btn");
  function expand(){  body.style.maxHeight="2000px";body.style.opacity="1";body.style.marginTop="14px";chevron.style.transform="rotate(180deg)"; }
  function collapse(){ body.style.maxHeight="0";body.style.opacity="0";body.style.marginTop="0";chevron.style.transform="rotate(0)"; }
  toggle.onclick = () => body.style.maxHeight === "0px" || body.style.maxHeight === "" ? expand() : collapse();
  closeBtn.onclick = collapse;
  questions.forEach((qq, qi) => {
    const card = document.createElement("div");
    card.style.cssText = "background:#fff;color:#1e1b4b;border-radius:12px;padding:16px 20px;margin-bottom:14px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.08);";
    card.innerHTML = `<p style="font-weight:700;margin:0 0 10px;">${qi+1}. ${qq.q}</p>`;
    qq.options.forEach((opt, oi) => {
      const btn = document.createElement("button");
      btn.textContent = opt;
      btn.style.cssText = "display:block;width:100%;min-height:44px;text-align:left;padding:10px 14px;margin:6px 0;border:2px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;color:#1e1b4b;cursor:pointer;font-size:.95em;transition:border-color .2s,background .2s;";
      btn.onmouseover = () => { if(!card.dataset.answered){ btn.style.borderColor="#667eea";btn.style.background="#f0f0ff"; }};
      btn.onmouseout  = () => { if(!card.dataset.answered){ btn.style.borderColor="#e2e8f0";btn.style.background="#fff"; }};
      btn.onclick = () => {
        if(card.dataset.answered) return;
        card.dataset.answered = "true";
        card.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => { b.style.cursor="default"; b.onmouseover=null; b.onmouseout=null; });
        if(oi === qq.correct){
          btn.style.borderColor="#48bb78";btn.style.background="#f0fff4";
          fb.innerHTML = "✅ Correct! " + qq.explanation;
          fb.style.color="#276749";fb.style.background="#f0fff4";
        } else {
          btn.style.borderColor="#fc8181";btn.style.background="#fff5f5";
          card.querySelectorAll("button")[qq.correct].style.borderColor="#48bb78";
          card.querySelectorAll("button")[qq.correct].style.background="#f0fff4";
          fb.innerHTML = "❌ " + qq.explanation;
          fb.style.color="#9b2c2c";fb.style.background="#fff5f5";
        }
        fb.style.padding="10px 14px";fb.style.marginTop="8px";
      };
      card.appendChild(btn);
    });
    const fb = document.createElement("div");
    fb.style.cssText = "border-radius:8px;font-size:.9em;transition:all .3s;";
    card.appendChild(fb);
    body.appendChild(card);
  });
  return outer;
}
```

# Anchor Phenomenon: Who's at Risk?

::: {.engage-box}
## 🌊 Japan, 2011 · Tonga, 2022

<div style="font-size: 1.2em; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; margin: 18px 0;">
Major earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and tsunamis happen all over the world, causing loss of life and property. Yet humans have been living continuously in these hazardous areas for thousands of years.
</div>

- **March 11, 2011, Japan:** a magnitude 9–9.1 earthquake struck off the coast. People felt the shaking first; then a **tsunami** reached the coast, killing **19,759 people** and causing a nuclear disaster that Japan is still recovering from.
- **January 15, 2022, Tonga:** the underwater volcano **Hunga Tonga–Hunga Ha'apai** exploded. It was heard thousands of miles away, and the tsunami that followed damaged villages across the Pacific.

**Videos from class:** [How the Tonga volcanic eruption rippled through the earth, ocean and atmosphere](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tNoA1n-rLhA) · [Japan Tsunami](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oWzdgBNfhQU) (first 1:24 only)
:::

![The ash plume from the Hunga Tonga–Hunga Ha'apai eruption spreads over the Pacific Ocean, photographed from the International Space Station on January 16, 2022. *Image: NASA (ISS066-E-117997), public domain.*](../images/unit3-oc-tonga-plume-iss.jpg){fig-alt="Photo from orbit showing Earth's curved horizon with a wide grayish-brown ash plume spread across the atmosphere above white clouds and blue ocean." width="100%"}

**Think about it** (your teacher asks these out loud):

- Have you ever felt an earthquake, or heard about an earthquake, tsunami, or volcano affecting people?
- What happened to people (and other living things) after those events?
- **Could events like these affect people where you live? Why do you think so?**

<div class="mind-blown">
🔊 The Tonga blast sent a pressure wave around the whole planet. Barometers around the world recorded it passing several times.
</div>

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
u3oWorld = {
  const topojson = await require("topojson-client@3");
  try {
    const t = await d3.json("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/world-atlas@2.0.2/countries-110m.json");
    return {countries: topojson.feature(t, t.objects.countries).features, land: topojson.feature(t, t.objects.land)};
  } catch (e) {
    let t;
    try { t = await d3.json("../world-110m.json"); } catch (e2) { t = await d3.json("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/world-atlas@2.0.2/land-110m.json"); }
    const key = t.objects.land ? "land" : Object.keys(t.objects)[0];
    return {countries: [], land: topojson.feature(t, t.objects[key])};
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Draws a cropped Equal Earth base map. bounds = [[west, south], [east, north]].
u3oMapFrame = (w, opts) => {
  const [[x0, y0], [x1, y1]] = opts.bounds;
  const xm = (x0 + x1) / 2;
  const box = {type: "MultiPoint", coordinates: [[x0, y0], [x0, 0], [x0, y1], [xm, y0], [xm, y1], [x1, y0], [x1, 0], [x1, y1]]};
  const projection = d3.geoEqualEarth().rotate(opts.rotate || [0, 0]).fitWidth(w, box);
  const path = d3.geoPath(projection);
  const h = Math.ceil(path.bounds(box)[1][1]);
  const svg = d3.create("svg").attr("viewBox", [0, 0, w, h]).attr("width", w).attr("height", h)
    .style("max-width", "100%").style("height", "auto").style("display", "block").style("border-radius", "10px")
    .attr("role", "img").attr("aria-label", opts.label);
  svg.append("rect").attr("width", w).attr("height", h).attr("fill", opts.ocean);
  svg.append("path").attr("d", path(d3.geoGraticule10())).attr("fill", "none").attr("stroke", "#ffffff").attr("stroke-opacity", 0.45);
  if (u3oWorld.countries.length) {
    svg.append("g").selectAll("path").data(u3oWorld.countries).join("path")
      .attr("d", path).attr("fill", d => opts.countryFill ? opts.countryFill(d) : opts.land).attr("stroke", opts.border).attr("stroke-width", 0.5);
  } else {
    svg.append("path").attr("d", path(u3oWorld.land)).attr("fill", opts.land).attr("stroke", opts.border).attr("stroke-width", 0.5);
  }
  return {svg, projection, h};
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Saved "circled" details, shared by the three texts and the Detail Tracker. Kept in localStorage when it is available.
u3oDetails = {
  const KEY = "u3o-tell-the-story-v1";
  let state = {details: [], story: ""};
  try {
    const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY));
    if (saved && Array.isArray(saved.details)) state = {details: saved.details, story: saved.story || ""};
  } catch (e) {}
  const subs = [];
  const persist = () => { try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(state)); } catch (e) {} };
  const notify = () => {
    persist();
    for (let i = subs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const s = subs[i];
      if (s.el.isConnected) s.seen = true;
      else if (s.seen) { subs.splice(i, 1); continue; }
      s.fn();
    }
  };
  return {
    has: id => state.details.some(d => d.id === id),
    list: () => state.details.slice(),
    toggle: d => {
      state.details = state.details.some(x => x.id === d.id) ? state.details.filter(x => x.id !== d.id) : [...state.details, d];
      notify();
    },
    remove: id => { state.details = state.details.filter(x => x.id !== id); notify(); },
    story: () => state.story,
    setStory: t => { state.story = t; persist(); },
    clear: () => { state = {details: [], story: ""}; notify(); },
    // fn re-runs on every change until el has been attached to the page and then removed
    subscribe: (el, fn) => subs.push({el, fn, seen: false})
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
}
```

## Text 1: Selection of Earthquakes and Volcanic Eruptions in Continuously Populated Regions {#text-1}

Text #1 is a **Map of Ancient Societies and Tectonic Hazards**. The base map shows **early civilizations (c. 8000–900 BCE)**: green dots are agricultural areas and purple dots are major civilizations. The numbered pins are the five call-out boxes. Tap a pin or a button to read a region's call-out box.

```{ojs}
    const [x, y] = projection([c.lon, c.lat]);
    const col = c.kind === "major" ? "#8e44ad" : "#27ae60";
    civ.append("circle").attr("cx", x).attr("cy", y).attr("r", (c.kind === "major" ? 4 : 5.5) * k)
      .attr("fill", col).attr("fill-opacity", c.kind === "major" ? 0.85 : 0.6).attr("stroke", "#fff").attr("stroke-width", 0.8)
      .append("title").text(`${c.name}${c.date ? ", " + c.date : ""} (${c.kind === "major" ? "major civilization" : "agricultural area"})`);
    if (c.kind === "agri" && w >= 560) {
      const dx = c.anchor === "end" ? -7 : c.anchor === "start" ? 7 : 0, dy = c.below ? 15 * k : c.anchor === "middle" ? -9 * k : 3;
      civ.append("text").attr("x", x + dx).attr("y", y + dy).attr("text-anchor", c.anchor)
        .attr("font-size", 9.5 * k).attr("font-weight", 700).attr("fill", "#1e6b3c").attr("paint-order", "stroke").attr("stroke", "#efe3c8").attr("stroke-width", 3)
        .text(c.name);
    }
  }
  const pins = svg.append("g");
  const draw = () => {
    pins.selectAll("*").remove();
    chips.replaceChildren(...u3oRegions.map(r => u3oChip(`${r.n}. ${r.region}`, r.region === wrap.value, r.color, () => pick(r.region))));
    for (const r of u3oRegions) {
      const on = r.region === wrap.value;
      const [tx, ty] = projection([r.lon, r.lat]), [px, py] = projection(r.pin);
      const g = pins.append("g").style("cursor", "pointer").attr("tabindex", 0).attr("role", "button").attr("aria-label", `Read the ${r.region} call-out box`)
        .on("click", () => pick(r.region)).on("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); pick(r.region); } });
      g.append("line").attr("x1", px).attr("y1", py).attr("x2", tx).attr("y2", ty).attr("stroke", r.color).attr("stroke-width", on ? 3 : 2).attr("stroke-dasharray", on ? null : "4 3");
      g.append("circle").attr("cx", tx).attr("cy", ty).attr("r", 4 * k).attr("fill", r.color);
      if (on) g.append("circle").attr("cx", px).attr("cy", py).attr("r", 21 * k).attr("fill", r.color).attr("fill-opacity", 0.25);
      g.append("circle").attr("cx", px).attr("cy", py).attr("r", 14 * k).attr("fill", on ? r.color : "#fff").attr("stroke", r.color).attr("stroke-width", 3);
      g.append("text").attr("x", px).attr("y", py).attr("dy", "0.35em").attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 14 * k).attr("font-weight", 800)
        .attr("fill", on ? "#fff" : r.color).text(r.n);
    }
  };
  const pick = name => {
    wrap.value = u3oText1State.pick = name;
    draw();
    wrap.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
  };
  draw();
  wrap.appendChild(svg.node());
  const legend = document.createElement("div");
  legend.style.cssText = "display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 16px;justify-content:center;font-size:.85em;margin-top:6px;";
  legend.innerHTML = `<span><span style="color:#27ae60;">●</span> Agricultural areas</span><span><span style="color:#8e44ad;">●</span> Major civilizations</span><span>① Call-out region</span>`;
  wrap.appendChild(legend);
  return wrap;
}
```

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## 🔎 About the dates in Text 1

The PTO lists the Vesuvius eruption as 70 CE. Most historians date it to **79 CE**. The 5,300 BCE eruption in Japan is usually linked to the **Kikai caldera**, south of Kyushu. Death tolls for very old events are estimates. The PTO's arrow for the Great Rift Valley points at Central Africa; on this map the pin points at the rift itself, in East Africa.
:::

## Text 3: Volcano Fatalities since 1500 {#text-3}

Text #3 is a **Washington Post** map built from the **Volcanic Fatalities Database (Brown et al.)**. Circles are sized by the number of fatalities caused by each volcano since 1500, and can include several eruptions over that period. Tap a size in the legend to show or hide it, and tap a circle to read about that volcano.

```{ojs}
  const w = width, k = Math.max(0.65, Math.min(1.1, w / 700));

  wrap.appendChild(svg.node());
  const marks = svg.append("g");
  let shown = [];
  // Circles overlap (e.g. Pelée and La Soufrière), so a tap picks the circle whose center is nearest
  const nearest = e => {
    const [mx, my] = d3.pointer(e);
    let best = null, bd = Infinity;
    for (const d of shown) {
      const [x, y] = projection([d.lon, d.lat]), dist = Math.hypot(x - mx, y - my);
      if (dist <= Math.max(12, u3oBinR[d.bin] * k + 4) && dist < bd) { best = d; bd = dist; }
    }
    return best;
  };
  svg.on("click", e => { const d = nearest(e); if (d) pick(d.id); })
    .on("pointermove", e => svg.style("cursor", nearest(e) ? "pointer" : null));
  const draw = () => {
    chips.replaceChildren(...u3oFatalityBins.map((b, i) => u3oChip(`● ${b}`, st.bins.has(i), "#e69b00", () => {
      st.bins.has(i) ? st.bins.delete(i) : st.bins.add(i);
      draw();
    })));
    marks.selectAll("*").remove();
    shown = u3oVolcanoes.filter(d => st.bins.has(d.bin)).sort((a, b) => b.bin - a.bin);
    for (const d of shown) {
      const on = d.id === wrap.value;
      const [x, y] = projection([d.lon, d.lat]);
      const g = marks.append("g").attr("tabindex", 0).attr("role", "button").attr("aria-label", `${d.name}, ${d.country}: ${u3oFatalityBins[d.bin]} deaths`)
        .on("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); pick(d.id); } });
      g.append("title").text(`${d.name}, ${d.country}: ${u3oFatalityBins[d.bin]} deaths since 1500`);
      g.append("circle").attr("cx", x).attr("cy", y).attr("r", Math.max(1.5, u3oBinR[d.bin] * k))
        .attr("fill", "#f9b233").attr("fill-opacity", 0.75).attr("stroke", on ? "#d63031" : "#5c3d00").attr("stroke-width", on ? 3 : 0.9);
    }
    if (w >= 520) {
      for (const d of shown.filter(d => d.labeled || d.id === wrap.value)) {
        const [x, y] = projection([d.lon, d.lat]);
        const r = u3oBinR[d.bin] * k + 3, lab = d.lab || "right";
        const [dx, dy, anchor] = {right: [r, 0, "start"], left: [-r, 0, "end"], above: [0, -r - 4, "middle"], below: [0, r + 6, "middle"]}[lab];
        marks.append("text").attr("x", x + dx).attr("y", y + dy).attr("dy", "0.35em")
          .attr("text-anchor", anchor).attr("font-size", 9 * Math.min(1, k)).attr("font-weight", 700)
          .attr("fill", d.id === wrap.value ? "#d63031" : "#333").attr("paint-order", "stroke").attr("stroke", "#fff").attr("stroke-width", 3)
          .style("pointer-events", "none").text(d.name.toUpperCase());
      }
    }
  };
  const pick = id => {
    wrap.value = st.pick = id;
    draw();
    wrap.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
  };
  draw();
  const legend = document.createElement("div");
  legend.style.cssText = "font-size:.85em;text-align:center;margin-top:6px;";
  legend.innerHTML = `Source: Brown et al., Volcanic Fatalities Database, via the Washington Post (Wonkblog). Names in capitals are labeled on the PTO map.`;
  wrap.appendChild(legend);
  return wrap;
}
```

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## 🔎 About these numbers

The PTO map adds up **all** eruptions of each volcano since 1500, so a circle can be bigger than any one eruption. The PTO map only names some volcanoes. The unlabeled circles on this page are identified by their location, and their notes come from other sources. Fatality counts for older eruptions are estimates and differ between sources.
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
u3oLive = {
  try {
    const r = await fetch("https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/feed/v1.0/summary/4.5_month.geojson");
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status);
    const j = await r.json();
    return {ok: true, quakes: j.features.map(f => ({lon: f.geometry.coordinates[0], lat: f.geometry.coordinates[1], depth: f.geometry.coordinates[2], mag: f.properties.mag, place: f.properties.place, time: new Date(f.properties.time)}))};
  } catch (e) {
    return {ok: false, quakes: []};
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const wrap = html`<div style="background:#fff;color:#1e1b4b;border-radius:12px;padding:16px 20px;margin:10px 0 18px;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.1);"></div>`;

    groups.replaceChildren(...[1, 2, 3].map(n => {
      const mine = all.filter(d => d.text === n);
      const sec = html`<div style="border-left:6px solid ${colors[n]};padding:4px 0 8px 12px;margin-bottom:14px;">
        <div style="font-weight:800;">${titles[n]} · ${mine.length} saved ${mine.length >= 2 ? "✅" : ""}</div>

        x.setAttribute("aria-label", "Remove " + d.label);
        x.onclick = () => u3oDetails.remove(d.id);
        row.appendChild(x);
        sec.appendChild(row);
      }
      const jot = html`<form style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:8px;">
        <input type="text" maxlength="300" placeholder="Jot your own detail from Text ${n}…" style="font-family:inherit;font-size:.95em;flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;min-height:40px;padding:6px 10px;border:2px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:8px;color:#1e1b4b;background:#fff;">
        <button type="submit" style="flex:0 0 auto;min-height:40px;padding:6px 14px;border:none;border-radius:8px;background:${colors[n]};color:#fff;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Add</button>
      </form>`;
      jot.querySelector("input").setAttribute("aria-label", `Your own detail from Text ${n}`);
      jot.onsubmit = e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const t = jot.querySelector("input").value.trim();
        if (t) u3oDetails.toggle({id: `t${n}-jot-${Date.now()}-${jotN++}`, text: n, label: "My note", detail: t});
      };
      sec.appendChild(jot);
      return sec;
    }));
  };
  u3oDetails.subscribe(wrap, paint);
  paint();

  const story = html`<div style="margin-top:6px;">
    <label style="display:block;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:6px;">📖 Our overall story: What is the phenomenon?</label>
    <textarea rows="5" placeholder="Earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and tsunamis…" style="font-family:inherit;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:10px;border:2px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:8px;font-size:1em;color:#1e1b4b;background:#fff;"></textarea>
    <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:8px;">
      <button type="button" class="copy" style="min-height:40px;padding:6px 16px;border:none;border-radius:50px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea 0%,#764ba2 100%);color:#fff;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">📋 Copy my notes</button>
      <button type="button" class="clear" style="min-height:40px;padding:6px 16px;border:2px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:50px;background:#fff;color:#9b2c2c;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Clear everything</button>
      <span class="msg" style="align-self:center;font-size:.9em;"></span>
    </div>
  </div>`;
  const ta = story.querySelector("textarea"), msg = story.querySelector(".msg");
  ta.value = u3oDetails.story();
  ta.oninput = () => u3oDetails.setStory(ta.value);
  story.querySelector(".copy").onclick = async () => {
    const all = u3oDetails.list();
    const text = [1, 2, 3].map(n => `${titles[n]}\n` + (all.filter(d => d.text === n).map(d => `- ${d.label}: ${d.detail}`).join("\n") || "- (none yet)")).join("\n\n")
      + `\n\nOverall story:\n${ta.value.trim() || "(not written yet)"}`;
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); msg.textContent = "✅ Copied!"; }
    catch (e) {
      const tmp = document.createElement("textarea");
      tmp.value = text;
      document.body.appendChild(tmp);
      tmp.select();
      let ok = false;
      try { ok = document.execCommand("copy"); } catch (e2) {}
      tmp.remove();
      msg.textContent = ok ? "✅ Copied!" : "⚠️ Couldn't copy here. Copy your notes into your packet by hand.";
    }
  };
  story.querySelector(".clear").onclick = () => {
    if (!confirm("Remove all saved details and your overall story?")) return;
    u3oDetails.clear();
    ta.value = "";
    msg.textContent = "Cleared.";
  };
  wrap.appendChild(story);
  return wrap;
}
```

::: {.key-idea}
### 💡 One way to tell the story

Earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and tsunamis are **not spread evenly**: they cluster in certain bands, like the edges of the Pacific and a belt from the Mediterranean across Asia. They have killed **hundreds of thousands** of people at a time, destroyed cities, and forced people to move. **Yet people have lived in these same regions continuously for thousands of years, and still do today.**
:::

# Performance Task Introduction: Evaluating Disaster Risk

::: {.explore-box}
## 🌐 Evaluating Disaster Risk

The **United Nations**, non-profit organizations, and governments around the world are interested in supporting populations at risk from disasters like earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and tsunamis. Unfortunately, **money available to fund this effort is limited**, so decisions need to be made about how much should be invested to reduce risk in these areas.

**Five areas have been identified as at risk to these disasters and of particular interest:**

1. The Mediterranean Basin
2. The Great Rift Valley
3. The Japanese Archipelago
4. Southeast Asian Mainland
5. Andes Region
:::

::: {.key-idea}
### 🎯 Your task in this unit

Investigate seismic disasters in order to **model how they occur** and **explain how they have affected populations in the past**, in order to better understand **how they put people and property at risk today**.
:::

# Initial Model

::: {.explain-box}
## 🧩 What causes earthquakes, tsunamis, and volcanoes to occur across the world? How do they cause loss of life and property?

**Individual:** Using what you already know, **develop an initial model** that illustrates:

- what causes an **earthquake**
- what causes a **volcanic eruption**
- how each of these hazards causes **loss of life and property**
:::

### 🗂️ Hazard Sorter: warm up your model

Each card describes a cause or an effect. Decide which hazard it belongs to, then compare with how scientists see it. There is no score; use it to collect ideas for your model.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
u3oHazardCards = [
  {f: "Rock along a fault suddenly slips, releasing energy that travels as waves through the ground", key: "Earthquake", why: "An earthquake is the shaking caused when stressed rock suddenly breaks or slips along a fault. The energy travels outward as seismic waves."},
  {f: "Molten rock (magma) rises toward the surface and gas pressure builds until it bursts out", key: "Volcano", why: "Volcanoes erupt when magma from inside Earth reaches the surface. Trapped gas can make eruptions explosive, like Tonga in 2022."},
  {f: "The sea floor suddenly moves up or down, pushing a huge volume of water", key: "Tsunami", why: "Tsunamis are usually caused by undersea earthquakes (Japan 2011, Sumatra 2004), but volcanic explosions and landslides can cause them too (Krakatau, Tonga)."},
  {f: "Buildings collapse because the ground shakes back and forth", key: "Earthquake", why: "Shaking itself rarely kills people. Collapsing buildings do. That is why building codes matter so much (Haiti 2010)."},
  {f: "Clouds of hot ash and gas race downhill and bury towns", key: "Volcano", why: "These pyroclastic flows destroyed Pompeii (Vesuvius) and St. Pierre (Pelée, 1902). They move too fast to outrun."},
  {f: "Coastal towns flood, sometimes thousands of kilometers from where it started", key: "Tsunami", why: "Tsunami waves cross whole oceans. The 2004 Sumatra tsunami killed people as far away as Africa."},
  {f: "Shaking loosens a mountainside and a landslide buries a town", key: "Earthquake", why: "The 1970 Peru earthquake (Text 1) triggered a landslide. Together they killed about 50,000 people."},
  {f: "Ash and gas block sunlight and ruin crops, so people starve months later", key: "Volcano", why: "After Laki (1783) and Tambora (1815), famine killed more people than the eruptions themselves."}
]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const wrap = html`<div style="margin:10px 0;"></div>`;
  const tally = html`<div style="text-align:center;font-weight:700;margin:8px 0 14px;">Sorted: <span>0</span> / ${u3oHazardCards.length} · Matched scientists: <span>0</span></div>`;
  wrap.appendChild(tally);
  let sorted = 0, matched = 0;
  const colors = {Earthquake: "#6c5ce7", Volcano: "#d63031", Tsunami: "#0984e3"};
  const icons = {Earthquake: "〰️", Volcano: "🌋", Tsunami: "🌊"};
  u3oHazardCards.forEach(item => {
    const card = html`<div style="background:#fff;color:#1e1b4b;border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:12px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.1);">
      <div style="font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;">${item.f}</div>
      <div class="btns" style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;"></div>
      <div class="fb" style="font-size:.92em;"></div>
    </div>`;
    const btns = card.querySelector(".btns"), fb = card.querySelector(".fb");
    ["Earthquake", "Volcano", "Tsunami"].forEach(choice => {
      const b = html`<button style="flex:1 1 90px;min-height:44px;border:2px solid ${colors[choice]};border-radius:8px;background:#fff;color:${colors[choice]};font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">${icons[choice]} ${choice}</button>`;
      b.onclick = () => {
        if (card.dataset.done) return;
        card.dataset.done = "1";
        sorted++;
        const ok = choice === item.key;
        if (ok) matched++;
        b.style.background = colors[choice]; b.style.color = "#fff";
        btns.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(x => x.style.cursor = "default");
        fb.style.cssText = `margin-top:8px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;background:${ok ? "#f0fff4" : "#f5f3ff"};color:#1e1b4b;`;
        fb.innerHTML = `<b>${ok ? "✅ Scientists agree:" : "🤔 Scientists would say:"} ${item.key}.</b> ${item.why}`;
        tally.querySelectorAll("span")[0].textContent = sorted;
        tally.querySelectorAll("span")[1].textContent = matched;
      };
      btns.appendChild(b);
    });
    wrap.appendChild(card);
  });
  return wrap;
}
```

### ✏️ In your packet: Initial Model (pp. 9–10)

- **Individual:** draw a model showing what causes an earthquake, what causes a volcanic eruption, and how each hazard causes loss of life and property.

- **Small group:** after sharing, develop a **group model** of the ideas you agree on.
- **Whole class:** look at other groups' models. List **two things** you saw that you think would be important for **everyone's** model to include (p. 10).

```{=html}
    el('u3omf-score').textContent = score;

    var fb = el('u3omf-feedback');

    el('u3omf-myth').disabled = true;

    el('u3omf-next').style.display = 'block';

  window.u3omfNext = function() { idx++; updateCard(); };
  window.u3omfRestart = function() {
```
